title: Checks for usage of x.get(0) instead of x.first() or x.front().
summary: Using x.first() for Vecs and slices or x.front() for VecDeques is easier to read and has the same result. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for usage of x.get(x.len() - 1) instead of x.last().
summary: Using x.last() is easier to read and has the same result. Clippy puts this lint in the complexity group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for usage of .get().unwrap() (or .get_mut().unwrap) on a standard library type which implements Index
summary: Using the Index trait ([]) is more clear and more concise. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.
